summary: Frontend-only (mobile 390x844) end-to-end testing of three new features: (1) Full DiCo templates, (2) On-screen signatures (titolare, responsabile tecnico, cliente ricevuta) for DiCo and (dichiarante, committente) for DiRi, and (3) persistence through reload and wizard edit. All 8 scenarios PASS. (a) Step 0 of DiCo wizard shows 'Modello DiCo completo' with testIDs template-dico-load / template-dico-save; the Save button is disabled until >=1 tipologia is selected (clicking it with empty tipologie does NOT open the save sheet). On step 3 the 'Salva questa DiCo come modello' section exposes the same two testIDs; saving via template-save-confirm shows 'Modello salvato ✓' in template-dico-msg. (b) Starting a NEW DiCo and applying the saved template through template-item-0 restores intervento, uso_edificio, progetto_da, progettista fields, tipologie (plant-c), descrizione_impianto, norme_tecniche, materiali_rows (with new ids), schema, allegati (schema removed + riferimento_dichiarazioni added) and allegati_facoltativi; committente / ubicazione are correctly NOT overwritten (verified 'Lucia Bianchi' remained in dico-committente after template-item-0). (c) Document detail /document/[id] renders 'Firme' card with sign-dichiarante, sign-responsabile, sign-cliente for DiCo and sign-dichiarante + sign-cliente for DiRi (no sign-responsabile on DiRi). Signature modal: signature-pad accepts mouse drag (page.mouse.down/move/up produce SVG <path>), signature-save is aria-disabled until paths exist, cliente modal shows signature-name prefilled with d.committente?.nome and the save stays disabled while the name is blank even after drawing. After save, sign-preview-<key> appears with subtitle 'name · DD/MM/YYYY' (today). sign-remove-<key> clears the signature and re-shows the empty 'Tocca per firmare' slot. signature-clear empties the pad and re-disables save; signature-cancel closes the modal without persisting. (d) Signatures persist across page reload AND across a wizard edit cycle (edit-button -> advance through all 4 steps -> 'Salva modifiche' keeps dichiarante+responsabile+cliente previews because the wizard spreads existing?.data?.firme into the saved payload). (e) Code review of /app/frontend/src/pdf/cna-html.ts confirms sig() correctly inlines an SVG for 'Il responsabile tecnico' and 'Il dichiarante' CNA boxes (field 13 area), the client receipt (fields 14 name, 15 date, 16 signature) and, on DiRi, dichiarante + committente ricevuta; document-html.ts sigSvg mirrors the same bindings. No React Native red screen, no deprecated expo-av/expo-barcode-scanner/expo-background-fetch usage. Minor non-blocking: during router.replace back to /document/[id] after a wizard edit, Playwright strict-mode briefly observed TWO 'sign-remove-cliente' nodes (old + new page tree) for ~a frame; resolved via .first() and the final DOM has exactly 1 element. Not an app bug.
critical_code_review_comments: signatures-card.tsx: SignatureModal is kept mounted (visible={!!open}) which is fine; initialName is passed and re-applied via onShow (setName(initialName ?? '')) — works correctly on react-native-web.

wizard/dico.tsx:213 and wizard/diri.tsx:153 both correctly spread firme: editing ? existing?.data?.firme : undefined (dico) and firme: existing?.data?.firme (diri) so signatures survive edit saves — verified end-to-end.
cna-html.ts sig(): if a signature has only a tap (no 'L' command) the pad component appends ' l0.1 0.1' to keep a valid path — PDF renders a tiny dot which is acceptable for a 'presence proof'.

Both TemplateBar instances on DiCo (step 0 + step 3) share the same testIDs (template-dico-load / template-dico-save) by design; only one is mounted at a time because step 0 and step 3 are conditionally rendered, so no duplicate-testID conflict in practice (confirmed via DOM inspection).
seed_data_creation: Created 3 ephemeral DiCo documents and 1 DiRi document inside the test tab's localStorage; one DiCo template 'Mio modello DiCo gas' was persisted for the load-template scenario. All data is user-local AsyncStorage and does not affect other sessions.
context_for_next_testing_agent: App is 100% offline, no login. Wizard step indices: DiCo step 1 requires >=1 plant-* before 'Avanti'; DiRi step 2 requires >=1 plant-*. Signature pad on web: use page.mouse.down()/move()/up() over [data-testid=signature-pad] — PanResponder picks up these as touch events. signature-save element has aria-disabled='true' when the save button is disabled (RN Pressable disabled prop). Deep-linking /document/<id> in a FRESH browser context will show 'Caricamento…' forever because the doc only exists in that tab's localStorage; always create via /wizard then follow the router.replace. During router.replace after wizard edit, Playwright may briefly see duplicate sign-* testIDs for a single frame — use locator(...).first or page.wait_for_timeout(400) after the save.
